title: Text to Image Generation and Editing: A Survey

bias_targets.methodology: Surveying existing literature to report on text-to-image models exhibiting unbalanced gender ratios, aligning with Western gender stereotypes in professional images, and producing stereotypical outputs for gendered prompts (e.g., generating predominantly pink toys when prompted with 'girl toys').
Surveying existing literature to report on the tendency of text-to-image models to over-represent individuals with lighter skin tones.
Surveying existing literature to report on models reinforcing Western-centric representations and stereotypes when given prompts for generic cultural imagery.
Surveying existing literature to report on models defaulting to Western stereotypes when prompted to generate images of 'religious sites'.
